facts.text: The Bobcat Promise covers tuition and mandatory fees up to 15 credit hours per semester for new entering freshmen with a FAFSA income of $50,000 or less.

sources.title: Bobcat Promise : TXST One Stop : Texas State University
sources.quote: The Bobcat Promise provides grants for tuition and mandatory fees up to 15 hours per semester to new entering freshmen with a FAFSA® income of $50,000 or less
